data.raw_text:
After the fire that struck, Bacolod City in the Philippines on September 12, Friday, this loyal soul never left the place he once called home.
On the very first day, the BACH Project team tried to rescue him, but he ran back inside the burning ruins, his heart refusing to let go.
Days passed, yet his hope never wavered. Last night, at around 9 p.m., they finally saw him again, alive, still waiting where love had once lived. He was then rescued and currently at Juan Veterinary Clinic. 

To his family, may you know that your dog’s loyalty is beyond measure. Through fire and fear, he waited. Through loss and uncertainty, he believed. His love never faltered, and his hope never left.
Because a loyal heart never stops waiting.

📷BACH Project
